prod_writes: Three data writes, no DDL. Each ran from its COMMITTED manifest as the --then of session:wait-for-gate (expected 2 min, census off) under the FIX-950 claim, run from the fix-1261 worktree with the primary checkout's .env.local.prod. (W1) docs/audits/2026-10-04-fix1260-senate-results.json advances[]: ONE SELECT … FROM proposals_advance_status(35 ids, passed_chamber). Gate OK 23:26:52Z; statement at 23:26:54.503Z. Moved 35 (floor_vote→passed_chamber 23, introduced→passed_chamber 12), held 0; read-back 35/35. The votes.metadata backfill half of W1 was NOT run (stopped_items). (W2) docs/audits/2026-10-04-fix1261-mint-artifacts.json: ONE direct UPDATE … WHERE status = current_status that bypasses the rank rule by design (D3). Gate OK 23:30:41Z; statement at 23:30:44.191Z. Moved 202 (failed→passed_chamber 139, failed→floor_vote 35, passed_chamber→floor_vote 28), skipped 0; read-back 202/202. (W3) docs/audits/2026-10-04-fix1262-voice-vote-passages.json: ONE SELECT … FROM proposals_advance_status(350 ids, passed_chamber). Gate OK 23:34:22Z; statement at 23:34:27.469Z. Moved 350 (in_committee 197, introduced 153), held 0; read-back 350/350. proposals n_dead_tup went 4,051 → 4,086 → 4,288 → 4,638 (95,289 live). No VACUUM, CALL, migration or pipeline ran. Every other prod contact was a read: db-query --prod, the manifest builds and dry runs, and session:held. The only external calls were HTTPS GETs to senate.gov: 1 live read plus 1,893 rolls at ≥ 500 ms.
stopped_items: W1's votes.metadata backfill. The prompt's premise was 'UPDATE roll_calls … 1,893 rows by PK — seconds; not a bulk rewrite; no VACUUM'. The tree contradicts it: there is no roll_calls table (prod to_regclass NULL, 23:00 UTC). The result lives on every member's votes row, so the backfill is 163,251 UPDATEs on a 989k-row, 1,073 MB, 14-index table. Its BEFORE UPDATE trigger stamps votes.updated_at, the watermark the EC votes arm (FIX-1139) and the fix1178a rate signature key on. 163k dead tuples sit below votes' autovacuum floor, so a VACUUM tail would be owed (FIX-943). Nothing reads the value except the writer. Stopped and filed as FIX-1265. The advances half of W1 ran, because its premise (proposals by id, through the RPC) held. The re-fetched results are the evidence of record in the manifest, which W2 reads directly.
